string.name: desc
string.value: Constant attacks focus your concentration, increasing your Abnormal Status Resistance. Resisting an Abnormal Status while this buff is in effect will trigger a cooldown on the skill. Also increases Abnormal Status Resistance and All Elemental Resistances permanently.

string.name: h
string.value: While attacking Abnormal Status Resistance will increase by #x% for #time sec regularly. When an Abnormal Status is resisted, Cooldown: #cooltime sec. \n[Passive Effects: Abnormal Status Resistance and all Elemental Resistances increase by #asrR%]
